title: Nice package, but not a very strong scent
text:
Nice package, but not a very strong scent. I work in our basement, so I use incense to cover all those strange basement odors. I had high hopes for this one, but it just didn't do a lot to cover up other odors.
The packaging is great and it definitely looks hand made. The sticks are long, about 10.5 inches and come nicely wrapped in a very nice box.
I had read reviews before getting it that said the scent was not very strong, but it looked nice so I thought I'd try it anyway. I got the Tibetian Angelica and it burns well, but just doesn't really have a scent. Even if you smell it without burning, the scent is faint.
For me, the whole reason to burn incense is to get a pleasant aroma, and this doesn't do that. If you want just a hint of scent, then you might like it but if you are looking for incense that gives you a nice aroma this isn't it.
